web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.title: Your time week
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.multiple: {label} · {hours} h across {n} entries · choose an entry
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.empty: No assigned open tasks, last-week tasks or current entries match this scope. Use Add time to choose another permitted task.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.hint: Blank cells are suggestions. Enter hours, then press Enter or leave the cell to save. Hatched days show time away; you can still record work on those days. Use entry details for notes or explicit removal. Totals include recorded entries only.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.unknownHint: Provisional or unavailable daily inputs leave the week’s capacity unavailable. Daily provisional figures stay labelled.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.multipleHint: Each entry keeps its own hours and note. Choose an entry to edit or remove; the cell’s total is never saved over an individual entry.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.hoursRule: Enter positive hours up to 24 with at most two decimal places. Clear or zero does not remove an entry; use entry details to remove it.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.retryHint: The save result is unknown. Retry these same hours to check the original request safely.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.timeWeek.savedAwaiting: Saved. Waiting for the recorded entry to refresh; use Reload if it does not appear.
